title: get_project_summary result
description: What get_project_summary returns: the session's globals and its size, with no per-track detail. A read tool, so it carries no undo report — nothing changed. Every field is required, because a summary with a field missing is indistinguishable from a session that has no tempo, and the agent would have to guess which.

projectName.description: Name of the open REAPER project file, without path or extension. Empty for a session that has never been saved, which is worth telling the producer about before an alias is learned (Requirement 8.10).

tempo.description: Project tempo in beats per minute at the start of the timeline. The tempo at bar one only: tempoChangeCount says whether it stays there.

trackCount.description: Number of tracks in the project, excluding the master track, which sits outside the indexed track list.

markerCount.description: How many project markers exist. A count rather than the list, which is read with list_markers when the arrangement's labelling matters.

regionCount.description: How many project regions exist. Read the list with list_regions.

tempoChangeCount.description: How many tempo or time signature changes exist beyond the initial values. Zero means the reported tempo and time signature hold for the whole timeline; anything else means they do not, and list_tempo_changes is the only way to find out where. Carried because a session that changes tempo at bar 33 is otherwise invisible.

denominator.description: Note value that represents one beat.
